description: This file extends the ChannelsStore class with asynchronous methods to load and save configuration schemas and data, apply UI configurations, and manage configuration values based on nested paths. It includes functions to access and modify deeply nested configuration structures and handles network requests via a GatewayConnection singleton.

methods.name: loadConfigSchema
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the configuration schema from the network, updating local state and UI hints.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Fetches current configuration snapshot asynchronously, updates local config states, and applies UI configuration.

methods.name: applyUIConfig
methods.description: Updates UI-related configuration based on the snapshot data, specifically the seamColorHex.

methods.name: channelConfigSchema
methods.description: Retrieves configuration schema for a specific channel ID.

methods.name: configValue
methods.description: Returns the configuration value at a specified nested path, with special fallback handling for 'channels'.

methods.name: updateConfigValue
methods.description: Sets a new value in the configuration draft at the specified path and marks it as dirty.

methods.name: saveConfigDraft
methods.description: Saves the current configuration draft asynchronously and reloads the configuration.

methods.name: reloadConfigDraft
methods.description: Reloads the configuration from the server.
